e3d40ecb7ce418fe9e5f641d2edecf3b1df36a41.english:
This enables emulation of the legacy vsyscall page.  Disabling
it is roughly equivalent to booting with vsyscall=none, except
that it will also disable the helpful warning if a program
tries to use a vsyscall.  With this option set to N, offending
programs will just segfault, citing addresses of the form
0xffffffffff600?00.
This option is required by many programs built before 2013, and
care should be used even with newer programs if set to N.
Disabling this option saves about 7K of kernel size and
possibly 4K of additional runtime pagetable memory.

translations.zh-CN:
这使人们能够模拟遗留的 vsyscall 页面。 残疾
它大致相当于 踢出Vsyscall=没有,除了。
如果程序, 也会禁用有用的警告
尝试使用阴道呼叫。 将这个选项设定为 N , 违法
程序将只是错误,引用表单的地址
0xffffffff600吗?
这一方案是2013年之前建立的许多程序所要求的。
如果设置为 N , 即使在新程序中使用时, 也应予以注意。
禁用此选项可保存大约 7K 个内核大小和
可能为4K 额外运行时间的分页存储器。

This option activates instrumentation for the entire kernel.
If you don't enable this option, you have to explicitly specify
UBSAN_SANITIZE := y for the files/directories you want to check for UB.
Enabling this option will get kernel image size increased
significantly.

e49e4b012ae083c4dfbba06f9ba9b2407308d3cb.english:
This option enables detection of unaligned memory accesses.
Enabling this option on architectures that support unaligned
accesses may produce a lot of false positives.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项可以检测不匹配的内存访问 。
对支持不匹配的架构启用此选项
访问可能会产生大量的假阳性.

f70f597c170dd2ad503454c01738ed81e59c4dd9.english:
This option enables detection of directly indexed out of bounds array
accesses, where the array size is known at compile time. Note that
this does not protect array overflows via bad calls to the
{str,mem}*cpy() family of functions (that is addressed by
FORTIFY_SOURCE).

translations.zh-CN:
此选项可以检测到直接索引出边界数组
accesses,即编译时已知数组大小。 请注意:
这并不能保护阵列通过坏呼声向
{str, mem}*cpy () 函数家族(由
[永久失效連結] (中文(简体) ).

6f1a91e27446d129413a6f872f374bcf4563b3ee.english: On Sanitizer warnings, abort the running kernel code

01cb7dec5a1395a96ea6363042c4238c07d56aa8.english:
Building kernels with Sanitizer features enabled tends to grow the
kernel size by around 5%, due to adding all the debugging text on
failure paths. To avoid this, Sanitizer instrumentation can just
issue a trap. This reduces the kernel size overhead but turns all
warnings (including potentially harmless conditions) into full
exceptions that abort the running kernel code (regardless of context,
locks held, etc), which may destabilize the system. For some system
builders this is an acceptable trade-off.

translations.zh-CN:
具有安全剂特性的建筑内核往往会生长
内核大小为 5%左右, 因为添加了所有调试文本
失败路径 。 为了避免这样, 卫生设备可以只是
发布陷阱。 这可以降低内核的高度,但可以全部转动
全部警告(包括可能无害的条件)
中止运行内核代码的例外(不管上下文,
可能破坏系统稳定。 一些系统
建筑师们,这是可以接受的权衡

cedd0e37e05154cda17c6a33071ab8b0668b82fb.english: Compile the kernel with KASan: runtime memory debugger

7343c280789b5483e718ff3cdaa6d5d0c6c19ed1.english:
Enables kernel address sanitizer - runtime memory debugger,
designed to find out-of-bounds accesses and use-after-free bugs.
This is strictly a debugging feature and it requires a gcc version
of 4.9.2 or later. Detection of out of bounds accesses to stack or
global variables requires gcc 5.0 or later.
This feature consumes about 1/8 of available memory and brings about
~x3 performance slowdown.
For better error detection enable CONFIG_STACKTRACE.
Currently CONFIG_KASAN doesn't work with CONFIG_DEBUG_SLAB
(the resulting kernel does not boot).

translations.zh-CN:
启用内核地址消毒器 - 运行时内存调试器,
用于查找出界访问和无后用错误。
这纯粹是一个调试功能,需要 gcc 版本
4.9.2或以后各段。 检测到堆栈的出界权限或
全球变量需要 gcc 5.0 或以后。
这个功能消耗了大约1/8可用的内存,并带来了
~x3 性能减速.
为了更好地检测出错误,可以使用CONFIG_STACKTRACE.
目前CONFIG_KASAN不与CONFIG_DEBUG_SLAB合作.
(由此产生的内核不启动).

fceeae85663323017aa58bfa8d49fffcf28966fd.english: Back mappings in vmalloc space with real shadow memory

75c57de75bc7f4230a3579b8db21eacde6ad9cc7.english:
By default, the shadow region for vmalloc space is the read-only
zero page. This means that KASAN cannot detect errors involving
vmalloc space.
Enabling this option will hook in to vmap/vmalloc and back those
mappings with real shadow memory allocated on demand. This allows
for KASAN to detect more sorts of errors (and to support vmapped
stacks), but at the cost of higher memory usage.
This option depends on HAVE_ARCH_KASAN_VMALLOC, but we can't
depend on that in here, so it is possible that enabling this
will have no effect.

translations.zh-CN:
默认情况下, vmalloc 空间的阴影区域是只读
零页。 这意味着KASAN无法发现涉及下列事项的错误:
Vmalloc空间。
启用此选项将连接到 vmap/ vmalloc 并备份
根据需求分配真实阴影内存的映射. 允许
用于 KASAN 检测更多类型的错误(并支持 vmapped)
堆栈),但以更高的内存使用率为代价.
此选项取决于 Have  ARCH  KASAN  VMALOC, 但我们不能
取决于这里,所以有可能允许
没有效果。

17742fe078e2c9715e0e8d10fb2ae2695829c9db.english:
Enables Generic KASAN.
Consumes about 1/8th of available memory at kernel start and adds an
overhead of ~50% for dynamic allocations.
The performance slowdown is ~x3.

translations.zh-CN:
启用通用 KASAN 。
在内核启动时消耗了大约1/8的可用内存并添加一个
动态分配管理费为~50%.
性能减速为~x3.

6d509c039969c5650d4e47df4f41f6377671ad8e.english:
Enables Software Tag-Based KASAN.
Supported only on arm64 CPUs and relies on Top Byte Ignore.
Consumes about 1/16th of available memory at kernel start and
add an overhead of ~20% for dynamic allocations.
May potentially introduce problems related to pointer casting and
comparison, as it embeds a tag into the top byte of each pointer.

translations.zh-CN:
启用基于软件标记的 KASAN.
仅支持arm64 CPU并依赖Top Byte 忽略.
在内核启动和
添加动态分配的间接费用为~20%。
可能带来与指针铸造和
比较,因为它将标记嵌入每个指针的上字节。

fbe9c8d5c3a3e290c29b0e00e1ef0fc575cb8d50.english:
Enables Hardware Tag-Based KASAN.
Supported only on arm64 CPUs starting from ARMv8.5 and relies on
Memory Tagging Extension and Top Byte Ignore.
Consumes about 1/32nd of available memory.
May potentially introduce problems related to pointer casting and
comparison, as it embeds a tag into the top byte of each pointer.

translations.zh-CN:
启用基于硬件标记的 KASAN 。
只支持从ARMv8.5开始的arm64 CPU并依赖
内存拖入扩展和顶字节忽略 。
大约消耗了第1/32个可用的内存.
可能带来与指针铸造和
比较,因为它将标记嵌入每个指针的上字节。

ede9ff58534b29b47ef629fa5c9dd79409c9b8e3.english:
Before every memory access compiler insert function call
__asan_load*/__asan_store*. These functions performs check
of shadow memory. This is slower than inline instrumentation,
however it doesn't bloat size of kernel's .text section so
much as inline does.

translations.zh-CN:
在每次内存访问编译器前插入函数调用
出道时间为:  asan load */ asan store *. 这些功能执行检查
影子记忆 这比内置仪表慢
不过它不是内核的... 文本部分的膨胀大小
就像内线一样

d43743ac743da9495efc904a70364c0cbe26cc5d.english:
Compiler directly inserts code checking shadow memory before
memory accesses. This is faster than outline (in some workloads
it gives about x2 boost over outline instrumentation), but
make kernel's .text size much bigger.
This requires a gcc version of 5.0 or later.

translations.zh-CN:
编译器直接插入代码检查阴影内存
内存访问。 速度快于大纲(一些工作量)
它比轮廓仪表有2个助推力 但是
使内核的文本大小大得多。
这需要gcc版本为5.0或更晚.

2a575b3363ad7520b4c6a012a0418b937d807ed7.english: Compile the kernel with code coverage for fuzzing

b09dc9bea6db2c538e3456aad0adf9d606fe1623.english:
KCOV exposes kernel code coverage information in a form suitable
for coverage-guided fuzzing (randomized testing).
If RANDOMIZE_BASE is enabled, PC values will not be stable across
different machines and across reboots. If you need stable PC values,
disable RANDOMIZE_BASE.
For more details, see Documentation/kcov.txt.

translations.zh-CN:
KCOV 以适合的形式曝光内核代码覆盖信息
用于覆盖制导模糊(随机测试)。
如果启用 RANDOMIZE  BASE, PC 值将不会在全局稳定
不同的机器和反弹 如果你需要稳定的PC值,
禁用 RANDOMIZE  BASE。
详情见Documents/kcov.txt.

8df22ea3d42f126f5e110e2c227beed3472fe531.english: Enable comparison operands collection by KCOV

bca7cd3501a3146f85961fb022c1a8543beadcb2.english:
KCOV also exposes operands of every comparison in the instrumented
code along with operand sizes and PCs of the comparison instructions.
These operands can be used by fuzzing engines to improve the quality
of fuzzing coverage.

translations.zh-CN:
KCOV还揭露了仪器中每个比较的操作
代码以及比较指令的操作大小和PC。
这些操作可以被模糊引擎用来提高质量
模糊的覆盖。

cdaaa72d8363e9c446288a31a4a7b1e16c32ded8.english:
If you are doing generic system call fuzzing (like e.g. syzkaller),
then you will want to instrument the whole kernel and you should
say y here. If you are doing more targeted fuzzing (like e.g.
filesystem fuzzing with AFL) then you will want to enable coverage
for more specific subsets of files, and should say n here.

translations.zh-CN:
如果你正在做通用系统调用模糊(例如: syzkaller),
那你会想把整个内核都装好,你应该
说你在这里。 如果你正在做更多的目标模糊(例如:
文件系统模糊与 AFL ) 那么您将想要启用覆盖
用于文件的更具体子集,并应在此表示 n。

c77ab53f9eaa4042eca1c1ba35141132dbd477cb.english: Compile the kernel with task resource/io statistics and accounting

9cc04f0c1b45476fec999163d078fab19ae62d70.english:
Enable the collection and publishing of task/io statistics and
accounting.  Enable this option to enable i/o monitoring in system
monitors.

translations.zh-CN:
能够收集和发布任务/io统计和
会计。 启用此选项以启用系统中的 i/o 监视
监视器。

f5dfaa62a12448569c2739201ff50beb8896e40a.english: Compile the kernel with pressure stall information tracking

f2a1ec9a71287a40e27701aa1e2647c899a0742b.english:
Collect metrics that indicate how overcommitted the CPU, memory,
and IO capacity are in the system.
If you say Y here, the kernel will create /proc/pressure/ with the
pressure statistics files cpu, memory, and io. These will indicate
the share of walltime in which some or all tasks in the system are
delayed due to contention of the respective resource.
In kernels with cgroup support, cgroups (cgroup2 only) will
have cpu.pressure, memory.pressure, and io.pressure files,
which aggregate pressure stalls for the grouped tasks only.
For more details see Documentation/accounting/psi.rst.
Say N if unsure.

translations.zh-CN:
收集显示 CPU、内存、内存的过度承诺度量表
和IO能力在系统中。
如果你在这里说Y, 内核会创建 /proc/pressure/ with the
压力统计文件 cpu,内存,和io. 这些将显示
系统部分或全部任务的墙上时间份额
由于相关资源的争议而推迟。
在有cgroup支持的内核中,cgroups(仅Cgroup2)会
有cpu.pressure,内存.pressure,和io.pressure文件,
用于组合任务的总压力档。
详情见文件/会计/psi.rst。
说N,如果不确定。

fe5777fc1065001652bac66fa860e80daf2d3011.english: Compile the kernel with symbol table information

885676486637d480d7a287a3718da3b60bad811b.english: This will give you more information in stack traces from kernel oopses.

translations.zh-CN: 这将给你更多的信息 从内核 ops 的堆栈痕迹。

3dc92ce5cbd7a38d03923292c815d9854a2d36a3.english: Compile the kernel with tracing support

2169cf270652ec67c011387484333c3439a28686.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Compile the kernel with tracing support.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:用跟踪支持来编译内核.

c8ce41df30d30d7b63ebf3849ba280119562d050.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Trace system calls.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:追踪系统呼叫.

659b1ce7c70928f1dde3a799e913892efce8faa1.english: Trace process context switches and events

36770bb3b66c4b2b17ab4bb9e870dc32a320e1b5.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Trace process context switches and events.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:追踪进程上下文开关和事件.
OpenWrt配置选项:函数跟踪器.

5bfac998de25c6da16a235ac838f7125197fe3c0.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Function graph tracer.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:函数图跟踪器.

0451461869b3a9fc4596e7e80ae45fb19fd59c2a.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Enable/disable function tracing dynamically.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:启用/功能可动态跟踪.
OpenWrt配置选项:函数配置器.

6118921bf887186e3f5b87efb9787bc5cb244ea9.english:
This option measures the time spent in irqs-off critical
sections, with microsecond accuracy.
The default measurement method is a maximum search, which is
disabled by default and can be runtime (re-)started
via:
echo 0 > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_max_latency
(Note that kernel size and overhead increase with this option
enabled. This option and the preempt-off timing option can be
used together or separately.)

translations.zh-CN:
此选项衡量在irqs-off关键值中花费的时间
区域,带有微秒精确度。
默认测量方法为最大搜索,即
默认已禁用, 可以启动运行时间( 重起)
通过:
回声 0 > /sys/内核/调试/跟踪/跟踪 max lentency
(注意内核大小和间接费用随此选项而增加)
启用 。 此选项和先发制人的时间选项可以是
合并使用或单独使用。 )

dad9bc001c83bd93d4fd2e8b1dc6294e0932c6c3.english:
This option measures the time spent in preemption-off critical
sections, with microsecond accuracy.
The default measurement method is a maximum search, which is
disabled by default and can be runtime (re-)started
via:
echo 0 > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_max_latency
(Note that kernel size and overhead increase with this option
enabled. This option and the irqs-off timing option can be
used together or separately.)

translations.zh-CN:
此选项可测量在先发制人的关键时间
区域,带有微秒精确度。
默认测量方法为最大搜索,即
默认已禁用, 可以启动运行时间( 重起)
通过:
回声 0 > /sys/内核/调试/跟踪/跟踪 max lentency
(注意内核大小和间接费用随此选项而增加)
启用 。 此选项和 irqs- off 计时选项可以是
合并使用或单独使用。 )

0df94ac1269123f91832c4917e0e17f0b94cfbb4.english:
Hist triggers allow one or more arbitrary trace event fields to be
aggregated into hash tables and dumped to stdout by reading a
debugfs/tracefs file. They're useful for gathering quick and dirty
(though precise) summaries of event activity as an initial guide for
further investigation using more advanced tools.
Inter-event tracing of quantities such as latencies is also
supported using hist triggers under this option.

translations.zh-CN:
Hist 触发器允许一个或多个任意跟踪事件字段
合并成散列表,然后通过读取
调试fs/ tracefs 文件. 用来快速地收集脏东西
(虽然准确)活动摘要作为初步指南
利用更先进的工具进行进一步调查。
活动间追踪诸如迟到等数量也是
支持在此选项下使用正弦触发。

e53bd0a0cf040a8fb084e0b57f7af4cbfa0a1fd0.english: Compile the kernel with debug information

a2ef5523ae45814dbeab0fe8e008005fea86bd2c.english: This will compile your kernel and modules with debug information.

translations.zh-CN: 这将以调试信息编译您的内核和模块 。

40f3f80516938ed8fba826a81851269840784aca.english:
Generate BPF Type Format (BTF) information from DWARF debug info.
Turning this on expects presence of pahole tool, which will convert
DWARF type info into equivalent deduplicated BTF type info.
Required to run BPF CO-RE applications.

translations.zh-CN:
从DWARF调试信息中生成BPF类型格式(BTF)信息.
打开预计的 pahole 工具, 该工具将转换
DWARF类型信息为等同的被分解的BTF类型信息.
要求运行 BPF CO-RE 应用程序.

a7feacd2b5fc102a80235d0ef354dda0c1471d82.english: Allow loading modules with non-matching BTF type info

fc08696c153c7c79ee5ea19efe56d334cee27c76.english:
For modules whose split BTF does not match vmlinux, load without
BTF rather than refusing to load. The default behavior with
module BTF enabled is to reject modules with such mismatches;
this option will still load module BTF where possible but ignore
it when a mismatch is found.

translations.zh-CN:
对于拆分的 BTF 不匹配 vmlinux 的模块, 加载不包含
BTF 而不是拒绝加载. 默认行为
模块 BTF 启用是拒绝有这种不匹配的模块;
此选项仍将尽可能加载模块 BTF, 但忽略
当发现不匹配时。

b0c610521257fdb4dc9b17e7718992fce9f77f17.english:
If you say Y here gcc is instructed to generate less debugging
information for structure types. This means that tools that
need full debugging information (like kgdb or systemtap) won't
be happy. But if you merely need debugging information to
resolve line numbers there is no loss. Advantage is that
build directory object sizes shrink dramatically over a full
DEBUG_INFO build and compile times are reduced too.
Only works with newer gcc versions.

translations.zh-CN:
如果您说 Y 在这里 gcc 命令生成更少调试
关于结构类型的信息。 这意味着工具
需要完整的调试信息( 如 kgdb 或 systemtap) 将不会
开心点 但如果你只需要调试信息
解析行号没有丢失。 优点是
构建目录对象大小在全数上急剧收缩
DEBUG INFO的构建和编译时间也被缩短了.
仅与较新的gcc版本合作.

1ede5498a9e945fd049327198405f91b9e6d920a.english: Compile the kernel with VM translations debugging

6c74e09eee37f81650a6d61bad885dc2ff877ae3.english:
Enable checks sanity checks to catch invalid uses of
virt_to_phys()/phys_to_virt() against the non-linear address space.

translations.zh-CN:
启用检查疗效检查以捕获无效用途
virt to phys ()/phys to virt () 对抗非线性地址空间.

62eb9fe7f7803b2eec3d666d3d7c65a170d728a5.english: Compile the kernel with dynamic printk

0792005cb77bfbd5875b22c6b7935229445f1043.english:
Compiles debug level messages into the kernel, which would not
otherwise be available at runtime. These messages can then be
enabled/disabled based on various levels of scope - per source file,
function, module, format string, and line number. This mechanism
implicitly compiles in all pr_debug() and dev_dbg() calls, which
enlarges the kernel text size by about 2%.

translations.zh-CN:
将调试关卡消息编译入内核, 而内核不会
否则可在运行时使用。 然后这些消息可以
基于不同范围――每个源文件,
函数、模块、格式字符串和行号。 该机制
在所有 pr  debug( ) 和 dev  dbg( ) 调用中默认编译
将内核文本大小扩大约2%。

94b2343615a12f8bce3a2558a11d39150d6a6600.english: Compile the kernel with early printk

7b4c33f7bb4fe029a9efe124168ce0ceb33df3e0.english:
Compile the kernel with early printk support.  This is only useful for
debugging purposes to send messages over the serial console in early boot.
Enable this to debug early boot problems.

translations.zh-CN:
以早期的平面支持来编译内核. 这只对
调试目的在早期启动时在串行控制台上发送消息 。
启用此功能以调试早期的启动问题 。

7bf0fc61c2e0f34ead45cfb6e300ed3e8efd1535.english: Compile the kernel with kprobes support

d59edbeb83fe51088dc523ebbfd44b96c10fbccf.english:
Compiles the kernel with KPROBES support, which allows you to trap
at almost any kernel address and execute a callback function.
register_kprobe() establishes a probepoint and specifies the
callback. Kprobes is useful for kernel debugging, non-intrusive
instrumentation and testing.
If in doubt, say "N".

translations.zh-CN:
在 KPROBES 支持下编译内核, 允许您陷阱
在几乎所有内核地址上执行调用函数。
注册  kprobe () 建立探测点并指定
调用。 Kprobes 可用于内核调试, 非侵入性
仪器和测试。
如果有疑问,就说"N".

84168462ade62d36a5eae62e3591691f58c0af01.english: Compile the kernel with BPF event support

4851913aa93db2f5d2caa5ffd2b2dd9eb31a8f1b.english:
Allows to attach BPF programs to kprobe, uprobe and tracepoint events.
This is required to use BPF maps of type BPF_MAP_TYPE_PERF_EVENT_ARRAY
for sending data from BPF programs to user-space for post-processing
or logging.

translations.zh-CN:
允许将 BPF 程序附加到 kprobe,上行和微分事件.
这需要使用 BPF MAP TYPE PERF EVENT ARRAY 类型的 BPF 地图
用于将 BPF 程序的数据发送到用户空间进行后处理
或伐木作业。

26533fb4673db1aba0ddc571ca0350907925712b.english: Support BTF function arguments for probe events

cc3a6f6dbf1665fd794c592764df0ad253e8ee28.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Support BTF function arguments for probe events.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt配置选项:支持BTF函数参数用于探测事件.

de6b600497e059e538c2714d3ff62aa31fb4ef07.english: Allow a TCP stream parser to be used with BPF_MAP_TYPE_SOCKMAP

a3e1398000b69b735b7f5dae126b52210086d18f.english: OpenWrt configuration option: Allow a TCP stream parser to be used with BPF_MAP_TYPE_SOCKMAP.

translations.zh-CN: OpenWrt 配置选项:允许使用 BPF MAP TYPE SOCKMAP 的 TCP 流剖析器.

chance to run.  The current stack trace is displayed upon

fb2aedaa806d2c8f0dc527c2f44fd7b54b304464.english: Compile the kernel with detect Hard Lockups

435be93ab4ae2a20b37f0133ae00d35a21791755.english:

Hardlockups are bugs that cause the CPU to loop in kernel mode
for more than 10 seconds, without letting other interrupts have a
chance to run.  The current stack trace is displayed upon detection

translations.zh-CN:

fa3052797899b322a72beae8f8d8563a62c2bae0.english: Compile the kernel with detect Hung Tasks

fa5e6a5337ca64215ec7186679f8c2cb05e32808.english:
Say Y here to enable the kernel to detect "hung tasks",
which are bugs that cause the task to be stuck in
uninterruptible "D" state indefinitely.
When a hung task is detected, the kernel will print the
current stack trace (which you should report), but the
task will stay in uninterruptible state. If lockdep is
enabled then all held locks will also be reported. This
feature has negligible overhead.

translations.zh-CN:
说Y在这里使内核能够检测"饥饿任务",
错误导致任务被卡入
无间断"D"状态无限.
当检测到挂起的任务时,内核会打印
当前堆栈跟踪( 您应该报告), 但是
任务将处于不间断状态。 如果锁定是
启用后, 所有锁定也会被报告 。 这个
特性具有可忽略不计的间接费用。

warning message is printed along with dump of workqueue

"workqueue.watchdog_thresh" and its sysfs counterpart.

translations.zh-CN:

6f5c497b4c161303115a5a6b6e16fecbcb378993.english: Memory Resource Controller for Control Groups

58740a28ea9af35a53f26a3c84becc0699808823.english:
Provides a memory resource controller that manages both anonymous
memory and page cache. (See Documentation/cgroups/memory.txt)
Note that setting this option increases fixed memory overhead
associated with each page of memory in the system. By this,
20(40)bytes/PAGE_SIZE on 32(64)bit system will be occupied by memory
usage tracking struct at boot. Total amount of this is printed out
at boot.
Only enable when you're ok with these tradeoffs and really
sure you need the memory resource controller. Even when you enable
this, you can set "cgroup_disable=memory" at your boot option to
disable memory resource controller and you can avoid overheads
(but lose benefits of memory resource controller).
This config option also selects MM_OWNER config option, which
could in turn add some fork/exit overhead.

translations.zh-CN:
提供管理两种匿名的内存资源控制器
内存和页面缓存。 (见文件/小组/备忘录.txt)
注意设置此选项会增加固定内存的间接费用
与系统内存的每页相关。 通过这个
20(40)字节/PAGE SIZE 在32(64)bit系统中将被内存占用
使用跟踪脚步。 打印总数
在靴子上。
只有在你同意这些取舍的时候 才能进行
您确定需要内存资源控制器 。 即使你允许
您可以在您的启动选项中设置“ cgroup  disable=memory ” 。
禁用内存资源控制器并可以避免管理费用
(但丧失了内存资源控制器的好处).
此配置选项还选择了 MM  OWNER 配置选项, 该选项
反过来,还可以增加一些叉子/出站费。

14dbfc43412aefad32cd0e5bf7ef3ed0a07480ed.english:

the amount of memory used by kernel objects in the system. Those are
fundamentally different from the entities handled by the standard
Memory Controller, which are page-based, and can be swapped. Users of
the kmem extension can use it to guarantee that no group of processes
will ever exhaust kernel resources alone.

35cf267d4dbeb41b4ddbb056fe919c70c9be4f28.english:
This enables support for configuring Data Center Bridging (DCB)
features on DCB capable Ethernet adapters via rtnetlink.  Say 'Y'
if you have a DCB capable Ethernet adapter which supports this
interface and you are connected to a DCB capable switch.
DCB is a collection of Ethernet enhancements which allow DCB capable
NICs and switches to support network traffic with differing
requirements (highly reliable, no drops vs. best effort vs. low
latency) to co-exist on Ethernet.
DCB features include:
Enhanced Transmission Selection (aka Priority Grouping) - provides a
framework for assigning bandwidth guarantees to traffic classes.
Priority-based Flow Control (PFC) - a MAC control pause frame which
works at the granularity of the 802.1p priority instead of the
link (802.3x).

translations.zh-CN:
这样可以支持配置数据中心(DCB)
通过 rtnetlink 的 DCB 功能以太网适配器上的特性. 说"Y"
如果您拥有一个能够支持此功能的 DCB 以太网适配器
接口和您连接到一个 DCB 能力开关。
DCB是一个以太网增强的集合,它使得DCB能够
支持不同网络流量的NIC和开关
(高度可靠,没有下降,最佳努力与低)
latency)在以太网上共存.
DCB的特点包括:
加强传输选择(aka优先分组) - 提供
为交通类分配带宽保障的框架。
基于优先的流量控制(PFC) - MAC控制暂停框架,
工作在802.1p优先级的颗粒度,而不是
链接(802.3x).

18f468f7d5b57be6cba32cfe8f843c40b67e6632.english:
If enabled, Dropbear will use login() and logout() functions to record logins in utmp and wtmp files.
If disabled, see DROPBEAR_UTMP and DROPBEAR_WTMP options.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
如果启用, Dropbear 将使用登录 () 和登录 () 功能来记录 utmp 和 wtmp 文件的登录 。
如果禁用,请参见 DROPBEAR UTMP 和 DROPBEAR WTMP 选项。
默认: 已禁用 。

9fb7ad56531405c0cafd0520533ad48e5206b01e.english:
/var/log/wtmp is a record of all previous logins.
The file needs to be manually created - Dropbear will update it only if it already exists.
To view login history, use "last" command, available in Busybox but not included by default.
If enabled, Dropbear will add SSH logins to the record.
If disabled, SSH logins will not be recorded.
Warning: The wtmp record is considered a security and privacy risk by some.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
/var/log/wtmp是之前所有登录的记录.
文件需要手动创建 - Dropbear 只有在它已经存在的情况下才会更新它.
要查看登录历史,请使用 Busybox 中可用的“ last” 命令,但默认不包含 。
如果启用, Droppear 将会在记录中添加 SSH 登录 。
如果禁用, SSH 登录将不会被记录 。
警告: Wtmp记录被一些人视为安全和隐私风险.
默认: 已禁用 。
默认: /var/log/wtmp

172d7236462d2583d6522fcfd2a6b4c7cb646c31.english:
/var/run/utmp is a record of currently logged-in users.
To view logged-in users, use "w", "who" or "users" commands.
If enabled, Dropbear will keep it updated with users that log in via SSH.
If disabled, SSH logins will not be recorded.
Warning: The utmp record is considered a security and privacy risk by some.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
/var/run/utmp是目前登录用户的记录.
要查看登录的用户,请使用"w","who"或"用户"等命令.
如果启用, Dropbear 将会与通过 SSH 登录的用户保持更新 。
如果禁用, SSH 登录将不会被记录 。
警告:Utmp记录被一些人视为安全和隐私风险.
默认: 已禁用 。
默认 : / var/ run/ utmp

ac55858810da4cc974c262882f01f7c3f40f160d.english: Use pututline() to write to utmp

3c018d7bc9c7d821e02f2d9baacdcf1226bef8e5.english:
If enabled, Dropbear will use pututline() to write into the utmp file.
If disabled, Dropbear will write to utmp file directly.
PS: DROPBEAR_UTMP_PATH value is likely to be ignored if DROPBEAR_PUTUTLINE is enabled.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
如果启用, Dropbear 将使用 pututline () 写入 utmp 文件 。
如果禁用, Droppear 将直接写入 utmp 文件 。
PS:DROPBEAR UTMP PATH值如果启用DROPBEAR PUTUTLINE,很可能被忽略.
默认: 已禁用 。

03d6d99be69d01b964576c138affc26067ef9e47.english:
Dropbear will re-execute itself for each incoming connection
so that memory layout may be re-randomised (ASLR).
Exploiting Dropbear vulnerabilities becomes harder
but uses slightly more memory per connection.
Default: enabled, except devices with very low memory.

translations.zh-CN:
Dropbear 将重新执行每次连接
这样内存布局就可以被重新随机(ASLR).
利用滴水熊的脆弱性变得更加困难
但每次连接使用略多的内存.
默认: 已启用, 但内存非常低的设备除外 。

fa038ac18bdcc49d9aafd9eb8f4af0a26db2b354.english:
Enable support for compression using shared zlib library.
Compression slows down transfer speed, especially on low-power CPUs
found in routers, but may increase speed over slow network links
if the CPU is fast enough to handle both compression and encryption
at network speed.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
启用使用共享 zlib 库的压缩支持 。
压缩会减慢传输速度,特别是在低功率CPU上
在路由器中找到,但可能比慢的网络链接提高速度
如果 CPU 速度足以同时处理压缩和加密
在网络速度。
默认: 已禁用 。

0ca8a99be1d058b85058333794539855c7215e2f.english:
Add command line argument "-R" to generate hostkeys as-needed
when the first connection using that key type occurs.
This avoids the need to otherwise run "dropbearkey" and avoids
some problems with badly seeded /dev/urandom when systems first boot.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
添加命令行参数"-R"以生成所需的主机密钥
当第一个使用该密钥类型的连接发生时。
这样可以避免用其他方式运行“倒扣”并避免
在系统启动时,有些问题与种子播种不良/dev/urandom有关。
默认: 已启用 。

3f10a805b1b3243f73adf768bba0be1244fa00c0.english:
Enables support for authentication agent forwarding.
Server only: see DROPBEAR_CLI_AGENTFWD for client.
This allows the use of local client keys to run a second ssh client to connect from the server to another server, without the need to install the keys on the fist server too.
Common example: ssh to a server and use git on that server to push to github using local ssh keys, not the keys installed on the server.
Default: enabled.
SECURITY NOTES:
SSH agent forwarding might cause security issues (locally and on the server).
Hovewer, it's enabled by default for compatibility with previous OpenWrt/Dropbear releases.

translations.zh-CN:
启用对认证代理转发的支持 。
仅服务器:客户端参见 DROPBEAR CLI AGENTFWD.
这样可以使用本地客户端密钥运行第二个ssh客户端,从服务器连接到另一个服务器,而不需要在拳头服务器上安装密钥.
常见的例子: ssh to a server并使用该服务器上的 git 来用本地 ssh 键来推去 github,而不是安装在服务器上的密钥.
默认: 已启用 。
安全说明:
SSH代理转发可能会引起安全问题(当地和服务器上).
Hovewer,由于与之前的OpenWrt/Dropbear发布兼容,默认启用.

cd8d8a241f2c9e654b4dfef72f9a1b8a8e2c86a3.english:
Support remote port forwarding.
Server listens and forwards connections to client.
Server only; see DROPBEAR_CLI_REMOTETCPFWD for client.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
支持远程端口转发 。
服务器听取和转发连接到客户端.
只有服务器;客户端请参见 DROPBEAR CLI REMOTETCPFWD.
默认: 已启用 。

da9d18ca56ff0604d7a18bb77f18498bd0bd55a1.english:
Support local port forwarding.
Client listens and forwards connections to server.
Server only; see DROPBEAR_CLI_LOCALTCPFWD for client.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
支持本地端口转发 。
客户端监听并转发服务器的连接.
仅服务器;客户端参见 DROPBEAR CLI LOCALTCPFWD.
默认: 已启用 。

1d179918aa6e8c8a01a18c43ebc3fee7d68b1026.english: Local port forwarding: client TCP socket -> server unix socket

e8cd569566bbdb1ccd2dbd123fba5df43fbe289b.english:
Support local port forwarding to unix sockets.
Client listens and forwards connections to unix socket on server side.
Server only.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
支持本地端口转发到 unix 套接字 。
客户端在服务器侧聆听并转发 Unix 套接字的连接 。
只有服务器
默认: 已启用 。

b443168518a872b5a993e819e02f46c5fc7ce1b9.english:
Supports X11 forwarding.
OpenWrt doesn't have any Xorg programs by default.
Server only.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
支持 X11 转发 。
OpenWrt默认没有任何Xorg程序.
只有服务器
默认: 已禁用 。

195b9e22d4474720cf7e8c11da2ae2287a89a129.english:
Include the SCP file transfer program.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
包含 SCP 文件传输程序.
默认: 已启用 。

374821373d8093d1adf384efb04f300b2acc98be.english:
Enable running a SFTP server (such as the one included with OpenSSH).
The SFTP server program is not provided by Dropbear itself.
SFTP server must be installed as /usr/libexec/sftp-server
Default: enabled, except devices with very small flash.

translations.zh-CN:
启用运行 SFTP 服务器( 如包含 OpenSSH) 。
SFTP服务器程序不是由 Droppear 本身提供的.
SFTP 服务器必须安装为 /usr/libexec/ sftp- server
默认: 已启用, 但闪光非常小的设备除外 。

9d99f62b1166ab11ced0041a539de3da45056d03.english:
Build dbclient, the Dropbear SSH client.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
构建 db客户端, Dropbear SSH 客户端.
默认: 已启用 。

fcd0d77a78b7a55e857a9b87989273d1caac27de.english: Let user choose ciphers and MACs

bb30d41ffe9cac2d36b81dbadc13d6cdf7f5b44e.english:
Adds dbclient "-c" and "-m" command line options.
Allows using "-c <cipher list>" and/or "-m <MAC list>"
to choose preferred ciphers and MACs.
Run "dbclient -c help" to list supported ciphers
and "dbclient -m help" to list supported MACs.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
添加 db客户端"-c"和"-m"命令行选项.
允许使用"-c<密码列表>"和/或"-m<MAC列表>"
选择首选密码和MAC。
运行“ dbclient -c 帮助” 以列出支持的密码
和“ dbclient- m help” 来列出支持的MAC 。
默认: 已启用 。

6dbcc1fbf4eb759f878ff65b3d7e9363a540d0a0.english:
Whether to use some options from ~/.ssh/dropbear_config.
Supported top-most option is "Host" (no "Match" support is present).
Supported options for "Host" are:
* Hostname
* Port
* User
* IdentityFile
These options are well-documented in ssh_config(5) man page.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
是否使用 ~. ssh/ droppbear  config 的一些选项 。
支持的最上端选项是"Host"(不存在"Match"支持).
支持的"Host"选项是:
* 主机名
* 港口
* 用户
* 身份证
这些选项在 ssh config(5) man 页面中都有详细记载.
默认: 已禁用 。

099c95fff9eac4b5b4138e5fcc8e94f2dfaa049b.english:
Save a network roundtrip by sending a real auth request
immediately after sending a query for the available methods.
This is not yet enabled by default since it could
cause problems with non-compliant servers.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
通过发送真实的认证请求来保存网络回转
立即对可用方法发出查询。
这在默认情况下尚未启用,因为它可能
导致不符合要求的服务器出现问题。
默认: 已禁用 。

21a0f5e522e12efe8951b6ab154ce013a7732393.english:
Allow specifying the password for dbclient via the DROPBEAR_PASSWORD environment variable.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
允许通过 DROPBEAR  PASWORD 环境变量指定 db客户端的密码 。
默认: 已启用 。

a9639c54f0084c481f6c3ec41e82d5e745c06303.english:
Allow the use of a helper program for the ssh client.
The helper program should be specified in the SSH_ASKPASS environment variable,
and dbclient should be run with DISPLAY set and no tty.
The program should return the password on standard output.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
允许为 ssh 客户端使用帮助程序 。
帮助程序应在 SSH ASKPASS 环境变量中指定,
和db客户端应该运行 DSPLAY 设置和没有tty。
程序应该返回标准输出的密码.
默认: 已禁用 。

c231d4911a51d2fe6fe184916e03ce0d58d51aa3.english:
Enables support for authentication agent forwarding.
Client only: see DROPBEAR_SVR_AGENTFWD for server.
This allows the use of local client keys to run a second ssh client
to connect from the server to another server, without the need to install
the keys on the first server too.
Common example: ssh to a server and use git on that server to push to
github using local ssh keys, not the keys installed on the server.
Default: enabled.
SECURITY NOTES:
SSH agent forwarding might cause security issues (locally and on the server).
Hovewer, it's enabled by default for compatibility with previous OpenWrt/Dropbear releases.

translations.zh-CN:
启用对认证代理转发的支持 。
仅客户端: 服务器参见 DROPBEAR SVR AGENTFWD 。
这样可以使用本地客户端密钥运行第二个 ssh 客户端
从服务器连接到另一个服务器,不需要安装
第一个服务器上的密钥。
常见的例子: ssh to a server 并使用 git 在服务器上推到
github 使用本地 ssh 密钥,而不是安装在服务器上的密钥 。
默认: 已启用 。
安全说明:
SSH代理转发可能会引起安全问题(当地和服务器上).
Hovewer,由于与之前的OpenWrt/Dropbear发布兼容,默认启用.

9b5267983ddf3ba1eaaaa9969067835706958444.english:
Support local port forwarding.
Client listens and forwards connections to server.
Client only; see DROPBEAR_SVR_LOCALTCPFWD for server.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
支持本地端口转发 。
客户端监听并转发服务器的连接.
仅客户端;服务器请参见 DROPBEAR SVR LOCALTCPFWD.
默认: 已启用 。

c3e6ed454db9f037b42375e62253441f33178e72.english:
Support remote port forwarding.
Server listens and forwards connections to client.
Client only; see DROPBEAR_SRV_REMOTETCPFWD for server.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
支持远程端口转发 。
服务器听取和转发连接到客户端.
只有客户端; 服务器请参见 DROPBEAR SRV REMOTETCPFWD 。
默认: 已启用 。

296cd9e410e5617510472e77481e42b8a9b019bb.english:
Support "-J <proxycommand>" to run the connection through a pipe
to a program rather the normal TCP connection.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
支持“ -J < proxy command> ” 通过管道运行连接
到一个程序 而不是正常的 TCP 连接。
默认: 已启用 。

支持"-B<endhost:endport>"的Netcat-like转发.
默认: 已禁用 。

46401da565d3fbdb24935d71cf0161b9f9c2f47b.english:
Support "[user@]host[/port][,[user@]host/port],...]" connections.
This option is required to support multi-hop connections in Dropbear client as well as DROPBEAR_CLI_PROXYCMD.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
支持"[用户@]host [/port][,[用户@]host/port],.]"连接.
此选项用于支持 Droppear 客户端中的多跳连接以及 DROPBEAR  CLI  PROXYCMD 。
默认: 已启用 。

a2a8c07bb5f586d58e09df091add021b0987518b.english:
Specifies the maximum amount of time before the session key is renegotiated.
Note: it's not possible to configure this value in run-time.
Possible values: 600 (10 minutes) to 604800 (7 days)
Default: 28800 (8 hours)

translations.zh-CN:
指定会话密钥重新谈判前的最大时间。
注:无法在运行时配置此值.
可能值:600(10分钟)至604800(7天)
默认: 28800 (8小时)

e8509170f1c7cbb8de1f3ababdf4690287a5489c.english:
Specifies the maximum amount of data that may be transmitted or received
before the session key is renegotiated.
Note: it's not possible to configure this value in run-time.
Possible values: 65536 (64 KiB) to 2147418112 (2 GiB - 64 KiB)
Default: 1073741824 (1 GiB)

translations.zh-CN:
指定可传输或接收的最大数据量
在重新谈判会话密钥之前。
注:无法在运行时配置此值.
可能值: 65536 (64 KiB)至 2147418112 (2 GiB - 64 KiB)
默认: 1073741824(1 GiB)

faa28534d2d5dd1ff66743801f035180d62cc0fc.english:
Close connections to clients which haven't authenticated after specified timeout.
Note: it's not possible to configure this value in run-time.
Possible values: 30 to 3600 (1 hour)
Default: 300 (5 minutes)

translations.zh-CN:
关闭客户端的连接, 这些客户端在指定超时后尚未验证 。
注:无法在运行时配置此值.
可能值: 30-3600(1小时)
默认: 300 (5分钟)

ed36f8380cf8294431f78a2e822e9f4efe9cd658.english:
Default maximum number of failed authentication tries (server option).
This can be changed at run-time with the -T argument.
Possible values: 1 to 80 (from src/sysoptions.h)
Default: 10

translations.zh-CN:
失败认证尝试的默认最大次数( 服务器选项) 。
这可以在运行时随-T 参数而改变 。
可能值:1至80(来自src/sysoptions.h)
默认: 10

cb881b0fc810726cb1a94c0068e33429ae1301db.english:
Delay introduced before closing an unauthenticated session.
Can be set to, say 30 seconds, to reduce the speed of password brute forcing.
There is a risk of denial of service by setting this.
Note: it's not possible to configure this value in run-time.
Possible values: 0 to 3600 (1 hour)
Default: 0 (disabled)

translations.zh-CN:
在未经认证的会议结束前出现延误。
可以设定,比如30秒, 降低密码野蛮强迫的速度。
设定这一点有拒绝服务的风险。
注:无法在运行时配置此值.
可能值: 0-3600(1小时)
默认: 0 (残疾)

a172f68940974e3a6c61dbbd2a1c632dbd91bdf1.english:
Specify the number of clients allowed to be connected but not yet authenticated.
After this limit, connections are rejected.
This setting is per IP, to prevent DoS attacks.
Note: it's not possible to configure this value in run-time.
Possible values: 1 to 1024
Default: 5

translations.zh-CN:
指定允许连接但尚未认证的客户端数量 。
此限制之后, 连接会被拒绝 。
此设置是每个 IP, 以防止 DoS 攻击 。
注:无法在运行时配置此值.
可能值:1至1024
默认: 5

05e03a6d57f8bc5d6f6530ca7a0316b0ec5848fe.english:
Specify the number of clients allowed to be connected but not yet authenticated.
After this limit, connections are rejected.
This setting is the global number, to prevent memory exhaustion
when attacks come from different IPs.
Note: it's not possible to configure this value in run-time.
Possible values: 1 to 1024
Default: 30

translations.zh-CN:
指定允许连接但尚未认证的客户端数量 。
此限制之后, 连接会被拒绝 。
此设置是全局编号, 以防止内存耗尽
当攻击来自不同的IP。
注:无法在运行时配置此值.
可能值:1至1024
默认: 30

a8bfdf822f2b03c9243b205c9f33c70ab01640b4.english:
TCP connections require acknowledgement of received data.
Window size is the maximum number of bytes that can be sent
on a connection before having to wait for an ACK packet.
This amount of memory is allocated as a per-connection receive buffer.
Increasing this value can make a significant difference to network performance
when SSH is used for large data transfers (SCP, SFTP, tunnels)
and the CPU can handle the encryption at network speed.
This can be changed at run-time with the -W argument.
Possible values: 256 to 10485760 (10MiB, from src/sysoptions.h)
Default: 32768 (32 KiB) for devices with very low memory
and 262144 (256 KiB) otherwise.

translations.zh-CN:
TCP连接需要确认收到的数据。
窗口大小是可发送的最大字节数
在连接之前 等待一个ACK包。
这个内存量作为每个连接接收缓冲器分配.
提高这一价值可以对网络性能产生重大影响
当SSH被用于大数据传输时(SCP, SFTP, 隧道)
而CPU可以以网络速度处理加密.
这可以在运行时随-W参数而改变.
可能值:256至10485760(10MiB,来自src/sysoptions.h)
默认: 32768 (32 KiB) 内存极低的设备
和262144(256 KiB),否则。

2f0e15b028e634a7ff27bf15e734c043d69fe62c.english:
Ensure that data is transmitted every KeepAlive seconds.
Applies to both server and client.
This can be changed at run-time with the -K argument.
Possible values: 0 to 604800 (7 days)
Default: 0 (disabled)

translations.zh-CN:
确保数据每KeepAlive秒传输一次.
适用于服务器和客户端。
可在运行时随-K 参数更改 。
可能值:0至604800(7天)
默认: 0 (残疾)

582f7543075c07f4115d200ce73ca28ea75470d8.english:
If this many KEEPALIVES are sent with no packets received from the other side, disconnect.
Applies to both server and client.
Note: it's not possible to configure this value in run-time.
Possible values: 1 to 30
Default: 3

translations.zh-CN:
如果这么多KEEPALIVES被发送 没有从对方收到任何数据包,则断开.
适用于服务器和客户端。
注:无法在运行时配置此值.
可能数值:1至30
默认: 3

ab5575ddd015957b256a4c16c1e8cfb5ca8edc28.english:
If no traffic is sent/received in IDLE_TIMEOUT seconds, disconnect.
Applies to both server and client.
Note: values below 30 seconds are not recommended.
This can be changed at run-time with the -I argument.
Possible values: 0 to 604800 (7 days)
Default: 0 (disabled).

translations.zh-CN:
如果在 IDLE TIMEOUT 秒内没有发送/接收流量,则断开.
适用于服务器和客户端。
注:不建议数值低于30秒。
可在运行时用 - I 参数更改 。
可能值:0至604800(7天)
默认: 0 (残疾).

7eae8492a6fd6ab48dcefc8663eab66b3e643f4e.english:
This enables the following authenticated encryption cipher:
* 3des-ctr - CTR mode
* 3des-cbc - CBC mode
Some very old SSH implementations might only support 3DES.
Keeping this cipher enables a downgrade attack on the connection, if the client allows it.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
这样可以实现以下认证加密密码:
* 3des- ctr - CTR 模式
* 3des-cbc - CBC模式
一些非常古老的SSH执行可能只支持3DES.
如果客户端允许,保留这个密码可以对连接进行降级攻击.
默认: 已禁用 。

de5d53df36b7b903a8942494283ad9014c129fea.english:
This enables the following authenticated encryption cipher:
* aes128-gcm@openssh.com - GCM mode
* aes128-ctr             - CTR mode
* aes128-cbc             - CBC mode
Enables AES with 128 bit key size.
AES is very secure, but slow. It is preferred on systems with AES hardware acceleration.
Including both AES keysize variants (128 and 256) will result in a minimal size increase.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
这样可以实现以下认证加密密码:
* aes128-gcm@openssh.com - GCM模式
* aes128-ctr - CTR 模式
* aes128-cbc - CBC模式
启用带有128位密钥大小的 AES 。
AES很安全,但很慢。 在具有AES硬件加速度的系统上更受青睐.
将AES键形变体(128和256)都包括在内,将使尺寸最小地增加。
默认: 已启用 。

60bfd861c851ad971de90a7fe418fed61d535fb5.english:
This enables the following authenticated encryption cipher:
* aes256-gcm@openssh.com - GCM mode
* aes256-ctr             - CTR mode
* aes256-cbc             - CBC mode
Enables AES with 256 bit key size.
AES is very secure, but slow. It is preferred on systems with AES hardware acceleration.
Including both AES keysize variants (128 and 256) will result in a minimal size increase.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
这样可以实现以下认证加密密码:
* aes256-gcm@openssh.com - GCM模式
* aes256-ctr - CTR模式
* aes256-cbc - CBC模式
启用带有256位密钥大小的 AES 。
AES很安全,但很慢。 在具有AES硬件加速度的系统上更受青睐.
将AES键形变体(128和256)都包括在内,将使尺寸最小地增加。
默认: 已启用 。

891d366c5dbf1062291b5abfa3f0141dc2b26d2e.english:
This enables the following authenticated encryption cipher:
* chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com
ChaCha20 is a symmetric-key stream cipher.
Poli1305 is hash function used for authentication.
ChaCha20-Poly1305 provides both encryption and authentication
without any additional cipher modes or MACs.
These algorithms are generally faster than AES on CPUs without dedicated AES instructions.
Default: enabled.

translations.zh-CN:
这样可以实现以下认证加密密码:
* chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com
ChaCha20是一款对称的克流密码.
Poli1305是用于认证的散列函数.
ChaCha20-Poly1305提供加密和认证
没有额外的密码模式或MAC。
这些算法在CPU上一般比AES快,没有专门的AES指令.
默认: 已启用 。

d919cb68b53b4f36fc9e5dce6b2c259f393de3e7.english:
This enables the following authenticated encryption cipher:
* 3des-ctr   - 3DES
* aes128-ctr - AES128

* Aes256-ctr - AES256

48c19e6769eae53fa0f27b9761c268e203cc2e31.english:
This enables the following authenticated encryption cipher:
* 3des-cbc   - 3DES
* aes128-cbc - AES128
* aes256-cbc - AES256

Default: disabled.

* 3-cbc - 3DES
* aes128-cbc - AES128
* aes256-cbc - AES256

默认: 已禁用 。

d7927e9fb1c8079332ed09ea88f3ae7a57936c5a.english:
This enables the following authenticated encryption cipher:
* aes128-gcm@openssh.com - AES128
* aes256-gcm@openssh.com - AES256
The authentication part of the GCM can be attacked by ciphertext forgery.
Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
这样可以实现以下认证加密密码:
* aes128-gcm@openssh.com - AES128
* aes256-gcm@openssh.com - AES256
GCM的认证部分可以通过密码伪造来攻击.
默认: 已禁用 。

* hmac-sha1
SHA1 generates 160 bit hashes. They are considered weak when used for signing (sha1-rsa keys).
Very old implementations may need it.
Default: disabled.

这样可以实现以下消息认证代码:
* 马克-沙1
SHA1产生160位散列. 在用于签名时,它们被视为弱(sha1-rsa密钥).
非常古老的执行可能需要它。

b78f7611c941c335d9dc595d819b1b5fa79bfc45.english:

* hmac-sha2-256
SHA2 with 256 bit hash length.

13fe8332b3fc9279f2396dd996125b784e4f7e6d.english:

* hmac-sha2-512
SHA2 with 512 bit hash length is slower than SHA256 with little added benefits,

Default: disabled.

translations.zh-CN:
这样可以实现以下消息认证代码:
*hmac-sha2-512号机车
512位散列长度的SHA2比SHA256慢,几乎没有附加好处,
因为SHA256足够强大
默认: 已禁用 。

1e51b7f1a529f6ecb6df7330b9545c2cede51b26.english:

ac536532f3f6b1529b733b5482e2a5f864ff0865.english:

* ssh-rsa

It will be removed in future due to SHA1 insecurity.

a5d3c8fc724767b2fde43c7bb0c958f4e1a61eb8.english:

Possible values: 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192.

设置默认 RSA 密钥大小, 例如自动生成服务器密钥时 。

cd3a34ca8c4cdbfb24837d0f19578d6a51d3af98.english:
This enables the following public key algorithm:
* ecdsa-sha2-nistp256 - 256-bit elliptic curve
* ecdsa-sha2-nistp384 - 384-bit elliptic curve
* ecdsa-sha2-nistp521 - 521-bit elliptic curve
Along with FIDO/U2F also enables the following public key algorithm:
* sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com - 256-bit elliptic curve
ECDSA significantly faster than RSA or DSS, but slower than Ed25519.
Default: enabled, except devices with very small flash.

* ecdsa-sha2-nistp 256 - 256-位椭圆曲线

* sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com - 256位椭圆曲线

77686c0f0b63052bec307055e5ada54998f6fd88.english:

Ed25519 uses Curve25519 and SHA512 and is faster than RSA and ECDSA.
Default: enabled, except devices with very small flash.

与 FIDO/U2F 一起,还可以实现以下公钥算法:
* sk-sh-ed25519@openssh.com 页面存档备份,存于互联网档案馆.

默认: 已启用, 但闪光非常小的设备除外 。

a4edc4861cd76711dece35ed071e8998c2e5df2f.english: The SELinux Reference Policy project (refpolicy) is a complete SELinux policy that can be used as the system policy for a variety of systems and used as the basis for creating other policies. Reference Policy was originally based on the NSA example policy, but aims to accomplish many additional goals. The current refpolicy does not fully support OpenWRT and needs modifications to work with the default system file layout. These changes should be added as patches to the refpolicy that modify a single SELinux policy. The refpolicy works for the most part in permissive mode. Only the basic set of utilities are enabled in the example policy config and some of the pathing in the policies is not correct.  Individual policies would need to be tweaked to get everything functioning properly.

translations.zh-CN: SELinux参考政策项目(refpolicy)是一个完整的SELinux政策,可以用作各种系统的系统政策并用作创建其他政策的基础. 参考政策最初基于消极安全保证的范例政策,但旨在实现许多额外目标。 当前refpolicy并不完全支持OpenWRT,需要修改以配合默认系统文件布局. 这些修改应作为修改单一SELinux政策的Refpolicy的补丁来添加. 调整政策在多数情况下是允许的。 在实例政策配置中,只有一套基本公用事业被启用,政策中的一些路径并不正确。 需要调整个别政策,使一切正常运转。

f8b36209da7ac93029ff14d17a47d922c49827ee.english: OpenWrt non-physical true random number generator based on timing jitter

663918344242cd9941445f97d58645470336ac19.english: urngd is OpenWrt's micro non-physical true random number generator based on timing jitter. Using the Jitter RNG core, the rngd provides an entropy source that feeds into the Linux /dev/random device if its entropy runs low. It updates the /dev/random entropy estimator such that the newly provided entropy unblocks /dev/random. The seeding of /dev/random also ensures that /dev/urandom benefits from entropy. Especially during boot time, when the entropy of Linux is low, the Jitter RNGd provides a source of sufficient entropy.

translations.zh-CN: urngd是OpenWrt的微非物理真实的随机数生成器,基于计时快克. 使用Jitter RNG核心,rngd提供了一个 en源,如果它的 en能运行得低,则会被喂入Linux /dev/random设备. 它更新了 /dev/random Entropy 估计器,这样新提供的 Entropy 解锁 /dev/random 。 /dev/random的播种也确保了/dev/urandom从 en得到好处. 特别是在靴子时间,当Linux的 en值较低时,Jitter RNGd提供了足够 en值的来源.

848b1296f6a358f6fc520c6ef8ab0363a0ebd499.english: Atop is an ASCII full-screen performance monitor for Linux that is capable of reporting the activity of all processes (even if processes have finished during the interval), daily logging of system and process activity for long-term analysis, highlighting overloaded system resources by using colors, etcetera. At regular intervals, it shows system-level activity related to the CPU, memory, swap, disks (including LVM) and network layers, and for every process (and thread) it shows e.g. the CPU utilization, memory growth, disk utilization, priority, username, state, and exit code. In combination with the optional kernel module netatop, it even shows network activity per process/thread.

translations.zh-CN: Atop是Linux的ASCII全屏性能显示器,能够报告所有进程的活动(即使进程在间隔期间已经完成),日常记录系统和进程活动进行长期分析,通过使用颜色等来突出超载系统资源. 它定期显示与CPU,内存,互换,磁盘(包括LVM)和网络层相关的系统级活性,并显示每个进程(和线程),例如CPU的利用率,内存增长,磁盘利用率,优先级,用户名,状态,以及退出代码等. 它与可选内核模块netatop结合,甚至显示每个进程/线程的网络活性.

9103c3a635b581184d70ff577089414c3e091079.english: GNU gperf is a perfect hash function generator. For a given list of strings, it produces a hash function and hash table, in form of C or C++ code, for looking up a value depending on the input string. The hash function is perfect, which means that the hash table has no collisions, and the hash table lookup needs a single string comparison only.

ad54339779888620082299a54a3b574956020713.english: As hardware vendors cope with the thermal constraints on their products, more and more sensors are added, new cooling capabilities are introduced. To expose such relationship to the userspace, Linux generic thermal layer introduced sysfs entry at /sys/class/thermal with a matrix of symbolic links, trip point bindings, and device instances. To traverse such matrix by hand is not a trivial task. 'TMON' is conceived as a tool to help visualize, tune, and test the complex thermal subsystem.

translations.zh-CN: 随着硬件供应商应对产品受热限制,增加了越来越多的传感器,引入了新的冷却能力. 为了将这种关系暴露在用户空间上,Linux通用热层在/sys/class/取热时引入了sysfs条目,其中包含符号链接,出行点绑定,以及设备实例等矩阵. 手工穿越这种矩阵并不是一项微不足道的任务。 "TMON"被设想为帮助可视化,调谐,并测试复杂的热子系统的工具.

716cf4e5041f933ee0476c6c7c39a12f292741eb.english: Netfilter (IPv4/IPv6) module for matching cluster This option allows you to build work-load-sharing clusters of network servers/stateful firewalls without having a dedicated load-balancing router/server/switch. Basically, this match returns true when the packet must be handled by this cluster node. Thus, all nodes see all packets and this match decides which node handles what packets. The work-load sharing algorithm is based on source address hashing. This module is usable for ipv4 and ipv6. To use it also enable iptables-mod-cluster see `iptables -m cluster --help` for more information.

translations.zh-CN: 网络过滤器( IPv4/ IPv6) 模块, 用于匹配集群 此选项允许您在没有专用负载平衡路由器/ 服务器/ 开关的情况下构建网络服务器/ 状态防火墙的工作负载共享集群 。 基本上, 当数据包必须由这个集群节点处理时, 此匹配返回为真实 。 因此,所有节点都能看到所有的数据包,这个匹配决定了哪个节点处理什么数据包. 工作负荷共享算法基于源地址散列. 这个模块可用于ipv4和ipv6. 要使用它,还可以使用 iptables-mod-cluster 见`iptables -m cluster --help` 获取更多信息.

25b612b718c22bf1554667b3560db6f2f8065b0b.english: B.A.T.M.A.N. (better approach to mobile ad-hoc networking) is a routing protocol for multi-hop ad-hoc mesh networks. e23176bbc44e3f220bf8f7834c85b8cc8618d617.english:
This option enables the B.A.T.M.A.N. V protocol, the successor
of the currently used B.A.T.M.A.N. IV protocol. The main
changes include splitting of the OGM protocol into a neighbor
discovery protocol (Echo Location Protocol, ELP) and a new OGM
Protocol OGMv2 for flooding protocol information through the
network, as well as a throughput based metric.
B.A.T.M.A.N. V is currently considered experimental and not
compatible to B.A.T.M.A.N. IV networks.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项可实现B.A.T.M.A.N.V.协议,后续协议
目前使用的B.A.T.M.A.N.IV.协议。 主语
更改包括 OGM 协议拆分为邻
发现协议(Echo Location Protocol,ELP)和一个新的OGM
《关于通过
网络,以及基于吞吐量的衡量标准。
B.A.T.M.A.N.V.目前被认为是实验性的,而不是
兼容B.A.T.M.A.N.IV网络。

7b59c1d40b50f90d9253ffca8e5b93b9a1b332c4.english:
This option enables BLA (Bridge Loop Avoidance), a mechanism
to avoid Ethernet frames looping when mesh nodes are connected
to both the same LAN and the same mesh. If you will never use
more than one mesh node in the same LAN, you can safely remove
this feature and save some space.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许 BLA( Bridge 循环避免), 一种机制
以避免网格节点连接时以太网框架循环
同一局域网和网格 如果你永远不会使用
在同一局域网中一个以上的网点,可以安全取出
此特性并保存一些空间。

8a569718b0c37c632a7502bee447211cb0ab988b.english:
This option enables DAT (Distributed ARP Table), a DHT based
mechanism that increases ARP reliability on sparse wireless
mesh networks. If you think that your network does not need
this option you can safely remove it and save some space.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许基于 DHT 的 DAT( 分布式 ARP 表)
增加稀有无线的ARP可靠性的机制
网易网. 如果你认为你的网络不需要
此选项可以安全取出并保存一些空间。

c760aa40dd87fd0db2e8eff97ef9fef372d2474d.english:
This option enables the multicast optimisation which aims to
reduce the air overhead while improving the reliability of
multicast messages.

translations.zh-CN:
此选项允许多播优化, 目的是
减少空中高空飞行,同时提高
多广播消息。

9d5d61cd03f6a6fe5268fdc685ae23d22bd77be9.english:
This is an option for use by developers; most people should
say N here. This enables compilation of support for
outputting debugging information to the debugfs log or tracing
buffer. The output is controlled via the batadv netdev specific
log_level setting.

dbe7e57372a6ac4d35e289602c2de43eaaadb3cb.english:
This option will enable debug tracing output for the iwlwifi drivers
This will result in the kernel module being ~100k larger.  You can
control which debug output is sent to the kernel log by setting the
value in
/sys/module/iwlwifi/parameters/debug
This entry will only exist if this option is enabled.
To set a value, simply echo an 8-byte hex value to the same file:
% echo 0x43fff > /sys/module/iwlwifi/parameters/debug
You can find the list of debug mask values in:
drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/iwl-debug.h
If this is your first time using this driver, you should say Y here
as the debug information can assist others in helping you resolve
any problems you may encounter.

54c2bc295a03731ed66976bfbe760486e04c558c.english: This is an alternative driver for various Realtek RTL8XXX parts written to utilize the Linux mac80211 stack. In particular it does not yet support 40MHz channels and power management. However it should have a smaller memory footprint than the vendor drivers and benetifs from the in kernel mac80211 stack. It can coexist with drivers from drivers/staging/rtl8723au, drivers/staging/rtl8192u, and drivers/net/wireless/rtlwifi, but you will need to control which module you wish to load. RTL8XXXU_UNTESTED is enabled This option enables detection of Realtek 8723/8188/8191/8192 WiFi USB devices which have not been tested directly by the driver author or reported to be working by third parties. Please report your results!

3eb552eaaa0ab6c274ec4609cebd4f069192a518.english: OWFS is a suite of programs that designed to make the 1-wire bus and its devices easily accessible. The underlying principle is to create a virtual filesystem, with the unique ID being the directory, and the individual properties of the device are represented as simple files that can be read and written. Details of the individual slave or master design are hidden behind a consistent interface. The goal is to provide an easy set of tools for a software designer to create monitoring or control applications. There are some performance enhancements in the implementation, including data caching, parallel access to bus masters, and aggregation of device communication. Still the fundemental goal has been ease of use, flexibility and correctness rather than speed. This package contains the OWFS library.

translations.zh-CN: OWFS是一套旨在使一线总线及其装置易于取用的程序. 其根本原则是创建虚拟文件系统,以独有的ID为目录,设备的单个属性被作为简单的文件来表示,可以读取并写出. 单个奴隶或主设计的细节被隐藏在一个一致的界面后. 目标是为软件设计师创建监测或控制应用程序提供一套简单的工具. 实施中有一些性能增强,包括数据缓存,平行访问总线主机,以及设备通信的汇总. 资金的目标仍然是便于使用、灵活和正确,而不是速度。 此包包含 OWFS 库 。

818a0e54839ca2580a3258e423ab1db766da1773.english: Fwknop implements an authorization scheme known as Single Packet Authorization (SPA) for Linux systems running iptables.  This mechanism requires only a single encrypted and non-replayed packet to communicate various pieces of information including desired access through an iptables policy. The main application of this program is to use iptables in a default-drop stance to protect services such as SSH with an additional layer of security in order to make the exploitation of vulnerabilities (both 0-day and unpatched code) much more difficult. This package contains the libfko shared library.

translations.zh-CN: Fwknop针对运行iptables的Linux系统执行名为"单包授权"(SPA)的授权方案. 这种机制只需要一个加密的、非重放的包就可以传递各种信息,包括通过iptables政策进行预期访问。 这个程序的主要应用是使用iptables在默认投放姿势中保护像SSH这样的具有多一层安全功能的服务,以便让利用弱点(包括0天和无标码)更加困难. 此套件包含 libfko 共享库 。

6384169036cf733fc8b73b46a3156fd49b173d8e.english: GnuTLS is a secure communications library implementing the SSL, TLS and DTLS protocols and technologies around them. 34a3badf836f0821d1c90a4ac170337137cbe2b8.english:

be68bce401b9b0fb73b3a7acfe1c12a6ff831fa5.english:
This turns on -DOPENSSL_SMALL_FOOTPRINT.  This will save only
1-3% of of the ipk size.  The performance drop depends on
architecture and algorithm.  MIPS drops 13% of performance for
a 3% decrease in ipk size.  On Aarch64, for a 1% reduction in
size, ghash and GCM performance decreases 90%, while
Chacha20-Poly1305 is 15% slower.  X86_64 drops 1% of its size
for 3% of performance.  Other arches have not been tested.

translations.zh-CN:
打开了DOPENSSL SMALL FOOTPRINT。 这只能省钱
叶子大小的1-3分. 表现下降取决于
结构与算法。 MIPS降低13%的性能
a ipk尺寸减少3%。 在Aarch64上,减少1%
尺寸、ghash和GCM性能下降90%,而
Chacha20-Poly1305慢了15%. X86 64 缩小了1% 。
3%的成绩 其他拱门还没有测试.

ac351d50728f730f2e99047ab639f66584ec0d8f.english:

removing outdated algorithms, and encrypting more of the
protocol;
* to increase performance by reducing the number of round-trips
when performing a full handshake.

d27704ef13075d30ec7a33f5e6abbfa55716b325.english:
Don't count on the kernel driver to update the CTR-mode counter
(IV).  At least one driver does not update the IV as a workaround
for DMA issues.  With this option turned on, the engine will keep
track of the counter, and the IV will be sent with every update.
If fallback is enabled, then the counter needs to be updated by
the engine anyway, and sent with the request everytime there's a
switch from software to hardware, so this won't bring much gain in
that case.

计数器的音轨,四号将随每次更新一起被发送.

9518b85c37172ed43fbd81997a2dc8b659401f75.english: libConfuse is a configuration file parser library

6af4a7e75866c6cc5351c44a0ca2f91655f6c909.english: libConfuse is a configuration file parser library, licensed under the terms of the ISC license, and written in C. It supports sections and (lists of) values (strings, integers, floats, booleans or other sections), as well as some other features (such as single/double-quoted strings, environment variable expansion, functions and nested include statements). 6b664fa9128bee17d21eb2203c62d7cb4bddf9b3.english: This project (pronounced gen'-see-oh) is used to abstract stream I/O like serial port, TCP, telnet, UDP, SSL, IPMI SOL etc and offers a framework for giving a consistent view of various stream (and packet) I/O types. You create a gensio object (or a gensio), and you can use that gensio without having to know too much about what is going on underneath. You can stack gensio on top of another one to add protocol funcionality. For instance, you can create a TCP gensio, stack SSL on top of that, and stack Telnet on top of that. It supports a number of network I/O and serial ports.  Gensio can be used for sending and receiving ports, and it also supports establishing encrypted and authenticated connections. . 3161a3d4e2806019e7a464a3ce734eda54982d45.english: libmnl is a minimalistic user-space library oriented to Netlink developers. There are a lot of common tasks in parsing, validating, constructing of both the Netlink header and TLVs that are repetitive and easy to get wrong. This library aims to provide simple helpers that allows you to re-use code and to avoid re-inventing the wheel. The main features of this library are: . * Small: the shared library requires around 30KB for an x86-based computer. . * Simple: this library avoids complexity and elaborated abstractions that tend to hide Netlink details. . * Easy to use: the library simplifies the work for Netlink-wise developers. It provides functions to make socket handling, message building, validating, parsing and sequence tracking, easier. . * Easy to re-use: you can use the library to build your own abstraction layer on top of this library. . * Decoupling: the interdependency of the main bricks that compose the library is reduced, i.e. the library provides many helpers, but the programmer is not forced to use them.

translations.zh-CN: Libmnl是一个面向Netlink开发者的最小化用户-空间库. 在解析,验证,构建"Netlink"头和"TLV"上有很多常见的任务都是重复的,容易出错. 这个库旨在提供简单的帮助,使您能够重新使用代码并避免重出炉轮. 这个图书馆的主要功能是:. * 小:共享的图书馆需要30KB左右的基于x86的计算机. . *简单:这个库避免了复杂而细化的抽象,往往隐藏了Netlink的细节. . * 易用:库为Netlink-wise开发者简化了工作. 它提供功能,使套接字处理,消息构建,验证,解析和序列跟踪更加容易. . * 易再用: 您可以使用库来在本库上方自建抽象层. . *脱钩:构成图书馆的主要砖块的相互依存性被降低,即图书馆提供许多帮助,但程序员并不被迫使用.

Smartcard-based client certificates are also supported via a PKCS11 wrapper interface. - Abstract interface to parsing XML using libxml2 or expat, and wrappers for simplifying handling XML HTTP response bodies - WebDAV metadata support; wrappers for PROPFIND and PROPPATCH to simplify property manipulation.

930c95f53a5f8e05d5f5576a116020f7d1a2df76.english:
Enable JIT (Just-In-Time) compiler support.
Just-in-time compiling is a heavyweight optimization that can greatly
speed up pattern matching. However, it comes at the cost of extra
processing before the match is performed, so it is of most benefit when
the same pattern is going to be matched many times. This does not
necessarily mean many calls of a matching function; if the pattern is
not anchored, matching attempts may take place many times at various
positions in the subject, even for a single call. Therefore, if the
subject string is very long, it may still pay to use JIT even for
one-off matches. JIT support is available for all of the 8-bit, 16-bit
and 32-bit PCRE2 libraries and adds about 100KB to the resulting
libpcre2.so. JIT support applies only to the traditional Perl-compatible
matching function. It does not apply when the DFA matching function is
being used.
Enabling this option can give an about 10x performance increase on JIT
operations. It can be desireable for e.g. high performance Apache
mod_rewrite or HA-Proxy reqrep operations.
However, JIT should _only_ be enabled on architectures that are supported.
Enabling JIT on unsupported platforms will result in a compilation

7ed6e0a9dfec5b591cac1b2b1bb05d5e6c9008f9.english: NaCl (pronounced "salt") is a new easy-to-use high-speed software library for network communication, encryption, decryption, signatures, etc. NaCl's goal is to provide all of the core operations needed to build higher-level cryptographic tools. Sodium is a portable, cross-compilable, installable, packageable fork of NaCl (based on the latest released upstream version nacl-20110221), with a compatible API. The design choices, particularly in regard to the Curve25519 Diffie-Hellman function, emphasize security (whereas NIST curves emphasize "performance" at the cost of security), and "magic constants" in NaCl/Sodium have clear rationales. The same cannot be said of NIST curves, where the specific origins of certain constants are not described by the standards. And despite the emphasis on higher security, primitives are faster across-the-board than most implementations of the NIST standards.

translations.zh-CN: NaCl(发音为"盐")是一款新型易用高速软件库,用于网络通信,加密,解密,签名等. NaCl的目标是提供建造更高级密码工具所需的所有核心操作. Sodium是一种可移植,可交叉编译,可安装,可包装的NaCl分叉(基于最新发布的上游版nacl-20110221),有相容的API. 设计选择,特别是在Curve25519 Diffie-Hellman函数方面,强调安全性(因为NIST曲线以安全为代价强调"性能"),而"魔法常数"在NaCl/Sodium中有明确的理由. NIST曲线不能这么说,因为标准没有描述某些常数的具体起源。 而尽管强调更高的安全性,原始人的全面执行速度比大多数NIST标准的执行速度快.

1bdadaf642b2e81c9fd620f945e75dbc8b529d47.english:

Note: Selecting this option does not automatically enable trace logging.
It only includes support for --trace command line option and GUI.

44cb2d1b5f21ffb7a21e522d09df0c627de414b3.english:
Allow continuous recording of a selected TV channel in a circular memory or file buffer,
and allow clients playing that live TV channel to pause/rewind/replay/ffwd within the limits of the buffer.
Note: Timeshift must be supported by the clients too.
Note: Timeshift recording is continuous. It must be stopped manually. Recording on flash-based storage is NOT recommended!

translations.zh-CN:
允许在循环存储器或文件缓冲器中连续记录选定的电视频道,
并允许播放该电视直播频道的客户端在缓冲限度内暂停/倒放/回放/ffwd.

8b9431d66bbead7138cee47ac5b6eed608f12b40.english: Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV), an extension to the HTTP-protocol, allows authoring of resources on a remote web server.davfs2 provides the ability to access such resources like a typical filesystem, allowing for use by standard applications with no built-in support for WebDAV. davfs2 is designed to fully integrate into the filesystem semantics of Unix-like systems (mount, umount, etc.). davfs2 makes mounting by unprivileged users as easy and secure as possible. davfs2 does extensive caching to make the file system responsive, to avoid unnecessary network traffic and to prevent data loss, and to cope for slow or unreliable connections. davfs2 will work with most WebDAV servers needing little or no configuration.

translations.zh-CN: Web Distribed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV),是HTTP-protocol的一个扩展,允许在远程网络服务器上编写资源. davfs2提供了像典型文件系统那样访问此类资源的能力,允许标准应用程序在没有内置支持WebDAV的情况下使用. davfs2旨在将Unix-like系统(mount,umount等)完全整合入文件系统语义. davfs2使非特权用户的安装尽可能容易和安全。 davfs2进行广泛的缓存,使文件系统响应,避免不必要的网络流量并预防数据丢失,并应对缓慢或不可靠的连接. davfs2将和大多数WebDAV服务器合作,只需要很少或没有配置.

cdd874ae90f413d6a6d97a0002c507cb45300c98.english: OWFS is a suite of programs that designed to make the 1-wire bus and its devices easily accessible. The underlying principle is to create a virtual filesystem, with the unique ID being the directory, and the individual properties of the device are represented as simple files that can be read and written. Details of the individual slave or master design are hidden behind a consistent interface. The goal is to provide an easy set of tools for a software designer to create monitoring or control applications. There are some performance enhancements in the implementation, including data caching, parallel access to bus masters, and aggregation of device communication. Still the fundemental goal has been ease of use, flexibility and correctness rather than speed. This package contains the OWFS ftp server.

translations.zh-CN: OWFS是一套旨在使一线总线及其装置易于取用的程序. 其根本原则是创建虚拟文件系统,以独有的ID为目录,设备的单个属性被作为简单的文件来表示,可以读取并写出. 单个奴隶或主设计的细节被隐藏在一个一致的界面后. 目标是为软件设计师创建监测或控制应用程序提供一套简单的工具. 实施中有一些性能增强,包括数据缓存,平行访问总线主机,以及设备通信的汇总. 资金的目标仍然是便于使用、灵活和正确,而不是速度。 此软件包包含 OWFS ftp 服务器 。

3d918c30596fd5701f3d269c354adf8d627b959b.english: Fwknop implements an authorization scheme known as Single Packet Authorization (SPA) for Linux systems running iptables.  This mechanism requires only a single encrypted and non-replayed packet to communicate various pieces of information including desired access through an iptables policy. The main application of this program is to use iptables in a default-drop stance to protect services such as SSH with an additional layer of security in order to make the exploitation of vulnerabilities (both 0-day and unpatched code) much more difficult. This package contains the fwknop client.

translations.zh-CN: Fwknop针对运行iptables的Linux系统执行名为"单包授权"(SPA)的授权方案. 这种机制只需要一个加密的、非重放的包就可以传递各种信息,包括通过iptables政策进行预期访问。 这个程序的主要应用是使用iptables在默认投放姿势中保护像SSH这样的具有多一层安全功能的服务,以便让利用弱点(包括0天和无标码)更加困难. 此包包含 fwknop 客户端 。

bdd8a68ee67e23bf2b594a537b228c641bfb7134.english: iptables extensions for matching cluster. Netfilter (IPv4/IPv6) module for matching cluster This option allows you to build work-load-sharing clusters of network servers/stateful firewalls without having a dedicated load-balancing router/server/switch. Basically, this match returns true when the packet must be handled by this cluster node. Thus, all nodes see all packets and this match decides which node handles what packets. The work-load sharing algorithm is based on source address hashing. This module is usable for ipv4 and ipv6. If you select it, it enables kmod-ipt-cluster. see `iptables -m cluster --help` for more information.

translations.zh-CN: 匹配集群的 iptables 扩展 。 网络过滤器( IPv4/ IPv6) 模块, 用于匹配集群 此选项允许您在没有专用负载平衡路由器/ 服务器/ 开关的情况下构建网络服务器/ 状态防火墙的工作负载共享集群 。 基本上, 当数据包必须由这个集群节点处理时, 此匹配返回为真实 。 因此,所有节点都能看到所有的数据包,这个匹配决定了哪个节点处理什么数据包. 工作负荷共享算法基于源地址散列. 这个模块可用于ipv4和ipv6. 如果您选中它, 它可以让 kmod-ipt-cluster. 查看 `iptables -m cluster --help` 获取更多信息 。

642a2f746965c71b251343f599d7c064a6cedfc6.english: takes a list of prefixes in conventional format on stdin, and performs two optimisations to reduce the length of the prefix list. It removes any supplied prefixes which are supurfluous because they are already included in another supplied prefix (e.g., 203.97.2.0/24 would be removed if 203.97.0.0/17 was also supplied), and identifies adjacent prefixes that can be combined under a single, shorter-length prefix (e.g., 203.97.2.0/24 and 203.97.3.0/24 can be combined into the single prefix 203.97.2.0/23).

translations.zh-CN: 在 stdin 上取一个常规格式的前缀列表,并实现两个优化以缩短前缀列表的长度。 它去除任何已提供且因已经包含在另一个已提供前缀中而具有苏活性的前缀(例如,如果也提供203.97.2.0/24,则会去除203.97.0.0/17),并识别相邻前缀,这些后缀可被组合在一个更短的前缀下(例如,203.97.2.0/24和203.97.3.0/24可被组合到单一前缀203.97.2.0/23).

108f83eed63a7f846cd68e0b10eb8cc4fc6459ca.english: Avahi is an mDNS/DNS-SD (aka RendezVous/Bonjour/ZeroConf) implementation (library). It facilitates service discovery on a local network -- this means that you can plug your laptop or computer into a network and instantly be able to view other people who you can chat with, find printers to print to or find files being shared. This kind of technology is already found in MacOS X (branded 'Rendezvous', 'Bonjour' and sometimes 'ZeroConf') and is very convenient. . This package implements IPv4LL, "Dynamic Configuration of IPv4 Link-Local Addresses" (IETF RFC3927), a protocol for automatic IP address configuration from the link-local 169.254.0.0/16 range without the need for a central server. It is primarily intended to be used in ad-hoc networks which lack a DHCP server.

translations.zh-CN: Avahi是一个mDNS/DNS-SD(aka RendezVous/Bonjour/ZeroConf)执行(图书馆). 它为本地网络上的服务发现提供了便利——这意味着你可以将你的笔记本电脑或计算机插入网络,并立即能够查看其他人,你可以和他们聊天,找到打印机打印到或找到正在共享的文件. 这种技术已经在MacOS X(被命名为"Rendezvous","Bonjour",有时为"ZeroConf")中被找到,并且非常方便. . 这个软件包执行IPv4LL,"IPv4 Link-local addresses的动态配置"(IETF RFC3927),一个从链接-local 169.254.0.0/16范围自动配置IP的协议,不需要中央服务器. 它主要用于缺乏DHCP服务器的特设网络。

199a7c61314c6dda23694e7d1fcc797e20b19543.english:
With crypt(3) password storage scheme enabled, OpenLDAP can
receive and store SHA-256 and SHA-512 password hashes from
Samba AD-DC. If this option is disabled, synchronization of
passwords between Samba AD-DC (v4.5 and above) and OpenLDAP
requires use of cleartext passwords.
To enable crypt(3) password synchronization functionality:
1. Re-include crypt(3) support in OpenWRT by enabling 'Include
crypt() support for SHA256, SHA512 and Blowfish ciphers' option
in "Advanced configuration options (for developers)" ->
"Toolchain Options".
2. Provision AD-DC with 'password hash userPassword schemes'
option. For more information, see smb.conf manpage for details
on 'password hash userPassword schemes'.
3. Use a script to synchronize passwords from AD-DC to
OpenLDAP. See samba-tool manpage for 'user syncpasswords'.

translations.zh-CN:
启用密码(3) 密码存储方案后, OpenLDAP 可以
接收并存储 SHA-256 和 SHA-512 密码散列从
Samba AD-DC. (原始内容存档于2019-09-30). 如果禁用此选项, 则同步
Samba AD- DC( v4.5及以上) 和 OpenLDAP 之间的密码
需要使用清晰文本密码。
启用密码(3)密码同步功能:
1. 在 OpenWRT 中通过“ 插入” 重新包含密码(3) 支持
密码 () 支持 SHA256, SHA512 和 Blowfish 密码的选项

815e5653ff534ece1c26528d22026beaa4975736.english: Babel is a loop-avoiding distance-vector routing protocol for IPv6 and IPv4 with fast convergence properties. It is based on the ideas in DSDV, AODV and Cisco's EIGRP, but is designed to work well not only in wired networks but also in wireless mesh networks, and has been extended with support for overlay networks. Babel is an IETF standard protocol (RFC 8966).

949172d641910fd5651d0251ad35baf3a9a1123c.english: Prince is an open source implementation of the PopRouting Algorithm. It has been developed as a Google Summer of Code Project in collaboration with Freifunk and the University of Trento. Prince fetches topology data from a Link State routing daemon (OONF, OLSR, OSPF, etc), calculates the betweenness centrality using the topology and then computes the the timers' optimal values using these data. At the end of the computation the timers are pushed back to the routing daemon. Since v0.4 it supports both OONF and OLSRd.

translations.zh-CN: Prince是"流行算法"的开源执行. 它被开发为Google Summer of Code Project,与Freifunk和特伦托大学合作. Prince从 Link State 路由守护进程(OONF, OLSR, OSPF等)中获取地理学数据,使用地理学来计算介于两者之间的中心位置,然后使用这些数据来计算定时器的最佳值. 在计算结束时,计时器被推回到路由守护进程. 自v0.4起,它支持OONF和OLSRd.

4f3654df2a60b7f52f090e44c415531ac711e6b9.english: uAnytun is a tiny implementation of SATP the secure anycast tunneling protocol. SATP defines a protocol used for communication between any combination of unicast and anycast tunnel endpoints.  It has less protocol overhead than IPSec in Tunnel mode and allows tunneling of every ETHER TYPE protocol (e.g. ethernet, ip, arp ...). SATP directly includes cryptography and message authentication based on the methods used by SRTP.  It is intended to deliver a generic, scalable and secure solution for tunneling and relaying of packets of any protocol. Unlike Anytun which is a full featured implementation uAnytun has no support for multiple connections or synchronisation. It is a small single threaded implementation intended to act as a client on small platforms.

translations.zh-CN: uAnytun是一个小小的执行 SATP 安全的任何播报隧道协议。 SATP定义了一个协议,用于任何unicast和任意cast隧道端点的组合之间的通信. 它在隧道模式中比IPSec协议的上行协议更少,并且允许每个ETHER TYPE协议的下行协议(例如ethernet,ip,arp.). SATP直接包括基于SRTP所使用方法的加密和消息认证. 其目的是为任何协议包的地道和中继提供通用、可扩展和安全的解决办法。 与Anytun不同, Anytun 是全功能的实现 uAnytun 没有支持多个连接或同步 。 它是一个小型的单一线性执行,旨在作为小型平台的客户端。

3e0e830a35132ee7f2a34c61550f83a070636a8d.english: WireGuard is a novel VPN that runs inside the Linux Kernel and utilizes state-of-the-art cryptography. It aims to be faster, simpler, leaner, and more useful than IPSec, while avoiding the massive headache. It intends to be considerably more performant than OpenVPN.  WireGuard is designed as a general purpose VPN for running on embedded interfaces and super computers alike, fit for many different circumstances. It uses UDP. In order to improve the traffic diversion performance as much as possible, dae runs the transparent proxy and traffic diversion suite in the linux kernel by eBPF. Therefore, we have the opportunity to make the direct traffic bypass the forwarding by proxy application and achieve true direct traffic through. Under such a magic trick, there is almost no performance loss and additional resource consumption for direct traffic.

Use GnuTLS in place of OpenSSL for the core features of receiving
TLS connections from clients and making TLS connections to servers.
The GnuTLS support is still very much experimental and should be
tested before use.
SSL-Bump and certificate generation features are not yet supported
by GnuTLS builds. Nor are many other less commonly used Squid
TLS/SSL features.
squid.conf directives and configuration options which have undergone
name changes from 'ssl' to 'tls' prefix in Squid-4 have GnuTLS
support, unless explicitly stated otherwise.
Advanced configuration with specific selection of ciphers and
similar settings should still work, but needs the GnuTLS Priority
Strings instead of the OpenSSL options when using GnuTLS.

TLS/SSL 特性.

Squid-4 中的名称从 “ sl” 改为“ tls ” 前缀有 GnuTLS

25f72ae135598afa806512ad81e6447fb2a89251.english: alfred is a user space daemon for distributing arbitrary local information over the mesh/network in a decentralized fashion. This data can be anything which appears to be useful - originally designed to replace the batman-adv visualization (vis), you may distribute hostnames, phone books, administration information, DNS information, the local weather forecast ... alfred runs as daemon in the background of the system. A user may insert information by using the alfred binary on the command line, or use special programs to communicate with alfred (done via unix sockets). alfred then takes care of distributing the local information to other alfred servers on other nodes. This is done via IPv6 link-local multicast, and does not require any configuration. A user can request data from alfred, and will receive the information available from all alfred servers in the network.

translations.zh-CN: Alfred是一个用户空间守护进程,用于以分散的方式在网络/网络上发布任意的本地信息。 这些数据可能是任何看起来有用的东西 - 最初设计用来取代蝙蝠侠- adv可视化( vis), 您可以分发主机名, 电话簿, 管理信息, DNS 信息, 本地天气预报. Alfred runs as daemon in the system. 用户可以通过在命令行上使用alfred 二进制来插入信息,或者使用特殊程序来与alfred(通过unix sockets)进行通信. 然后Alfred负责将本地信息分发给其他节点上的其他Alfred服务器. 这通过IPv6链接-本地多播实现,不需要任何配置. 一个用户可以向Alfred请求数据,并将从网络中所有Alfred服务器获得可获得的信息.

8d06f76df119d572f0014a90df5ff4ef6873436c.english: Alarm Pinger (apinger) is a little tool which monitors various IP devices by simple ICMP echo requests. There are various other tools, that can do this, but most of them are shell or perl scripts, spawning many processes, thus much CPU-expensive, especially when one wants continuous monitoring and fast response on target failure.  Alarm Pinger is a single program written in C, so it doesn't need much CPU power even when monitoring many targets with frequent probes.  Alarm Pinger supports both IPv4 and IPv6. The code have been tested on Linux and FreeBSD.

translations.zh-CN: Alarm Pinger (apinger)是一个小工具,通过简单的ICMP回声请求来监测各种IP设备. 还有其他各种工具,可以做到这一点,但大多数工具是外壳或活页脚本,催生出许多过程,因此很多CPU-消耗性,特别是当人们想要对目标失败进行持续监测和快速响应时. Alarm Pinger是一个用C写成的单一程序,所以即使用频繁的探测器来监测许多目标,它也不需要太多的CPU能. 提醒平格同时支持IPv4和IPv6. 该代码已经在Linux和FreeBSD上进行了测试.

e5e5816700817b559a1816d06aa5678455b8526d.english: Conserver is an application that allows multiple users to watch a serial console at the same time. c23a95bf48f20eb21d67ff96b41cdd4ab408ad5e.english: external protocol is a general protocol for assisting setup of many virtual devices that lack proper protocol support in openwrt. Such as netavark, cni and netbird for example. External protocol is supposed to be managed with external software, not directly. external protocol works automaticly on the background and sets up netifd details when interface comes up or goes down. This allows one to easily add interface to a firewall zone. as a example use case, podman, with network where it's internal firewall and portmapper are disabled, control of firewalling, whether it was exposing ports or limiting/accepting access between networks, such as lan can be made through openwrt's own firewalling configuration if you used external protocol. podman example configuration could be as following: - lan network: 10.0.0.0/16 (255.255.0.0) - container network: 10.129.0.1/24 (255.255.255.0) Add a network configuration for your container network using external protocol. Then create firewall zone for it. You could create a new container/pod with static ip address 10.129.0.2 (as 10.129.0.1 as container network's gateway). Easily define permissions so that local networks can connect to container network, but not the other way around. Also you want to allow forwarding from/to wan. Now, as container cannot access local dns, make a rule for your firewall to accept connections from container network to port 53 (dns). Now all you have to do, is make redirects to your firewall and point them to 10.129.0.2 and connections from wan are redirectered to containers/pods. external protocol also works for other applications as well that are using veth/tun/etc devices and don't have a hand-tailored protocol available, such as vpn service netbird. Protocol has 3 settings: device, searchdomain and delay. Sometimes polling interfaces takes some time, and in that case you might want to add few seconds to delay. Otherwise, it can be excluded from configuration. Option for searchdomain is also completely optional. package was previously known as cni protocol but as it can be used on so many other things, naming became mis-leading and it was renamed to external protocol.

translations.zh-CN: 外部协议是协助设置许多在openwrt中缺乏适当协议支持的虚拟设备的一般协议. 例如:netavark,cni和netbird等. 外部协议应该是用外部软件管理,而不是直接管理. 外部协议在背景上自动工作,并在界面上下时设置网格细节. 这样可以方便地将接口添加到防火墙区. 作为例使用例, pockman, 拥有其内部防火墙和端口被禁用的网络, 控制防火墙, 无论是暴露端口还是限制/接受网络之间的访问, 例如: lan, 如果您使用外部协议, 可以通过 Openwrt 自己的防火墙配置实现 。 pockman实例配置如下: - lan网络: 10.0.0/16 (255.255.0.0) - 集装箱网络: 10.129.0.1/24 (255.255.05) 使用外部协议为您的容器网络添加网络配置 。 然后为此建立防火墙区. 你可以用静态的ip地址10.129.0.2(作为集装箱网络的网关,作为10.129.0.1)创建一个新的容器/孔. 方便地定义权限,以便本地网络可以连接到容器网络,但不能相反. 您也想要允许从/ to wan 转发 。 现在,由于容器不能访问本地 dns,请为您的防火墙制定规则,以接受从容器网络到端口53(dns)的连接. 现在,你要做的是, 使方向转向防火墙, 并将其指向10.129.0.2, 从wan的连接被重定向到容器/孔。 外部协议也用于其他正在使用veth/tun/etc设备的应用程序,并且没有手订协议可用,如vpn服务网鸟. 协议有3个设置:设备,搜索域和延迟. 有时投票界面需要一些时间,在这种情况下,你可能想要增加几秒钟来延迟. 否则,它可以被排除在配置之外. 搜索域选项也是完全可选的 。 软件包以前被称为cni协议,但是由于它可以用于其他很多事物,命名变得错误地引导,并被更名为外部协议.

0835ee6e8d4872976c481ebaeeb591f2f0643992.english: Global Socket allows two workstations on different private networks to communicate with each other. Through firewalls and through NAT - like there is no firewall. The TCP connection is secured with AES-256 and using OpenSSL's SRP protocol (RFC 5054). It does not require a PKI and has forward secrecy and (optional) TOR support. The gsocket tools derive temporary session keys and IDs and connect two TCP pipes through the Global Socket Relay Network (GSRN). This is done regardless and independent of the local IP Address or geographical location. The session keys (secrets) never leave the workstation. The GSRN sees only the encrypted traffic. The workhorse is 'gs-netcat' which opens a ssh-like interactive PTY command shell to a remote workstation (which resides on a private and remote network and/or behind a firewall).

translations.zh-CN: Global Socket允许不同私人网络上的两个工作站互相通信. 通过防火墙和NAT - 就像没有防火墙。 TCP连接与AES-256安全,并使用OpenSSL的SRP协议(RFC 5054). 它不需要公用钥匙基础结构,并有前向保密和(可选的)职权范围支持。 gsocket工具获得临时会话密钥和ID,并通过Global Socket Relay网络(GSRN)将两根TCP管连接. 不论当地IP地址或地理位置如何,都这样做。 会话键( 秘密) 永远不会离开工作站 。 GSRN只看到加密流量. 工作马是"gs-netcat"(gs-netcat),它打开了类似于 ssh 的交互式 PTY 命令 shell 到远程工作站(它居住在私人和远程网络上和/或防火墙后).
